title: Mitigating harm in language models with conditional-likelihood filtration
reasoning: The paper focuses on value alignment and harm mitigation in language models. It proposes a methodology to identify and remove harmful content (racism, jingoism, hate speech) to align models with researcher-written values. It evaluates this using toxicity benchmarks and human labeling to distinguish between harmful and non-harmful (benign) text, which is an ethical evaluation of model output and training data.
